hold_reason: Refund for order 265 (amount_cents 10903) was requested in this batch and signed by Alpha Co, but list_refunds shows no such refund. Refunds for orders 260 and 263 are present. Payouts were not recorded for any customer. Needs human review to confirm whether the order 265 refund was applied before paying out.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds, but W2 reports only two applied. Before paying anyone I need to check the refunds table directly to confirm whether order 265 is missing.
